{{UK general election opinion polling|1955|1959|1964|1966|1970}}
In the run-up to the [[1966 United Kingdom general election|1966 general election]], various [[Opinion poll|polling organisations]] conducted [[Opinion poll|opinion polling]] to gauge voting intention amongst the general public. Such polls, dating from the [[1964 United Kingdom general election|previous election]] in 1964 to polling day on 31 March 1966, are listed in this article.

== Graphical summaries ==
[[File:1966_UK_election_polling_graph.svg|thumb|850px|center|UK opinion polling for the 1966 election {{columns-list|colwidth=18em|
 {{Legend-line|#0087DC solid 5px|Conservative}}
 {{Legend-line|#DC241f solid 5px|Labour}}
 {{Legend-line|#FAA61A solid 5px|Liberal}}
}}]]

== Polling results ==

All Data is from PollBase<ref>{{Cite news|url= https://www.markpack.org.uk/opinion-polls/|title=PollBase: British voting intention opinion polls since 1943|work=Mark Pack|access-date=2021-02-15|language=en-GB}}</ref>
